data.name: Hotel Indigo Guanajuato by IHG
data.address: C. Pardo 5, Col. Centro, 36000 Guanajuato, Gto., Mexico
data.description:
Off Highway 110, this contemporary hotel on a cobbled side street in a commercial area is a 14-minute walk from the leafy grounds of Jardín de la Unión and 15 minutes’ walk from the Museum of the Mummies of Guanajuato.
Featuring vibrant murals, the hip rooms provide flat-screen TVs, Wi-Fi and coffeemakers. Suites add sitting areas, minifridges, microwaves and wet bars.
There's a fashionable restaurant and an airy, relaxed lobby lounge. Breakfast and parking are available.
